news.title: NATO outlines €2.7 billion in technology needs at İzmir event
news.description: NATO’s technology agency outlined around 2.7 billion euros in potential procurement opportunities at NATO Edge 2026 in İzmir, where officials called for closer cooperation with industry to deliver military technology more quickly.
